operations.name: Outside Vendor – Closed-Die Forging Supply
operations.setup_note: Supplier produces the near-net 6082-T6 closed-die forging with the central body, lugs, flange, cutouts, slots, radii, and peripheral notches incorporated in the die tooling. Forging thermal processing and certification to TM-2005 are included in the purchased blank.

operations.name: Forge Flash Trim and Blend
operations.setup_note: Support the incoming near-net forging without loading the functional boss surfaces. Remove residual trim-line flash and blend affected radii smoothly without notches or stress risers.

operations.name: Pre-Machining Forging NDT
operations.setup_note: Inspect the cleaned aluminium forging before machining so laps, seams, cold shuts, or surface-breaking cracks are rejected before value-added work. Process the order as a vendor inspection lot with traceability to TM-2005 material certification.

operations.name: CNC Turn – First End
operations.setup_note: Locate the irregular near-net forging in dedicated soft jaws on the forged flange and support as required; indicate the boss before cutting. Face the first flange side and canned-cycle rough and finish turn the central cylinder to establish datum axis C.

operations.name: CNC Turn – Second End
operations.setup_note: Flip and locate in protected soft jaws from finished datum cylinder C, controlling axial position from the first turned side. Face the opposite flange side to establish datum B, then canned-cycle rough and finish the outer cylindrical boundary.

operations.name: VMC – Straddle Milling, Slotting and Cross Drilling
operations.setup_note: Locate the part in a dedicated gang fixture from turned datum C and flange face B; straddle-mill the four opposing arm flats together to establish datum A. Without unloading, spotface the lug pads and machine the left slot and right clearance hole from the established datums.

operations.name: Final Bench Deburr and Clean
operations.setup_note: Deburr the turned shoulders, milled flats, spotfaces, slot, and both sides of the through features without rolling material onto datum surfaces. Break all remaining sharp edges to the drawing maximum and clean the completed parts.

operations.name: Final Shop-Floor Inspection
operations.setup_note: Locate from datums A, B, and C and perform the final sampling inspection with dedicated plug, snap, height, and flatness gauges. Verify the boss diameters, flange face, arm flats, hole or slot positions, overall condition, and absence of detrimental forging defects.

clarifications.question: What is the complete CAD-defined depth and three-dimensional extent of peripheral notches F15?
clarifications.suggested_default: Produce F15 entirely in the closed-die forging and perform no separate contour milling.

clarifications.question: What is the complete CAD-defined depth and end condition of inner central slot F16?
clarifications.suggested_default: Produce F16 as a through feature in the closed-die forging, consistent with feature-graph assumption A12.

clarifications.question: What is the complete CAD-defined depth and three-dimensional extent of outer central cutouts F17?
clarifications.suggested_default: Produce F17 entirely in the closed-die forging and perform no separate pocket milling.

clarifications.question: Does the Ø80 outer boundary F14 define the finish-turned outside diameter of central flange F02?
clarifications.suggested_default: Treat F14 as the finish-turned outer cylindrical boundary of the central flange region.

clarifications.question: Is left slotted hole F03 intended to be drilled at its lobe locations and then finish slot-milled through?
clarifications.suggested_default: Spot and drill the slot lobe locations, then finish the through slot with one production slot-milling pass.

assumptions.text: ALM-TURN-002 is treated as the more specific override to ALM-FORG-002: the turning stage is split into two mandatory opposed spindle setups, followed by one consolidated VMC setup.
Features F05-F07 and F11-F19 are primarily near-net forged features; only the explicitly identified datums, cylindrical boundaries, arm flats, spotfaces, and holes receive machining.
The purchased forging is supplied and certified in the specified 6082-T6 condition, so no separate post-forge solution-treatment or artificial-aging operation is routed.

Billet sawing, billet heating, die loading, and intermediate forging stages from the forging template are supplier-controlled activities included in the purchased closed-die forging rather than separate Almity operations.

Separate shot blasting or descaling is omitted because the aluminium forging is assumed to arrive clean after supplier processing; residual trim-line material is removed and blended at the finish bench.

Turning-template center drilling, boring, grooving, threading, parting, and lathe chamfering are omitted because the near-net forging has no axial bore, groove, thread, or bar-fed part-off requirement; final edge breaking is performed at the bench.

Milling-template saw cutting, perimeter profiling, pocket milling, reaming, tapping, counterboring, and separate contour blending are omitted under the near-net forging and consolidated bar-pin machining corrections.

Hole-making pilot drilling, peck drilling, reaming, boring, tapping, and countersinking are omitted because F03 and F04 are short through clearance features with no H7 fit, thread, or deep-hole requirement.
Circular machined patches F09 and F10 are interpreted as spotfaces centered on the lug hole and slot locations and are machined in the consolidated VMC setup.
Pending confirmation, F03 is routed by drilling its lobe locations followed by a single finish slot-milling pass; no multi-pass pocket or perimeter profiling is used.
